scope: V2 exploratory one-seed screening, fixed before the completion of first V2 training
decision: Use validation for screening. Expand selected structural and distillation settings to three seeds. Preserve all V2 runs and report results on the already-observed test as exploratory.

selection_rule.selection_data: pre-existing selection subset, weights selected on full validation; exploratory
selection_rule.objective: mean validation accuracy over all listed budgets, unweighted; tie selects lower mean cost, then immediate KD
selection_rule.comparison: choose between residual_kd_seed42 and residual_delayed_kd_seed42; always expand residual_seed42 as no-KD control
selection_rule.test_access: new V2 test evaluation deferred until all six selected runs complete and are frozen
